name: @pipeworx/mcp-new-jersey-code

tools.name: nj_statute_section
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the New Jersey Statutes (N.J.S.A.) — New Jersey state law — by citation, plus its amendment history where the source lists one. "N.J.S.A. 2C:11-3" is murder; "39:4-50" is driving while intoxicated; "46:8-1" is a landlord-tenant statute. Returns the statutory text, a parsed amendment_history line when the section has been amended (empty for an original, unamended section), and says explicitly that a prior point-in-time version is not available through this source. Keyless. Use for "what does N.J.S.A. 39:4-50 say" or to check a citation a case or bill relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "2C:11-3" (murder), "39:4-50" (DWI), or "46:8-19" (security deposits). The part before the colon is the Title.

tools.name: nj_statute_search
tools.description: Search the New Jersey Statutes (N.J.S.A.) BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "security deposit interest", "landlord grounds for eviction", "possession of weapons for unlawful purposes". Returns ranked sections with their citations (where parseable) and headings; use nj_statute_section afterward for the full text of one. Full-text search, so it answers questions no citation lookup can. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "security deposit interest". A few plain words works better than a long sentence — this engine ANDs every word.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-new-jersey-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the new-jersey-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
